title: India's AI skills gap: 40th of 98 countries
takeaways_title: The AI skills gap in 5 numbers
takeaways: India ranks 40th of 98 countries on Coursera's AI-human skills index.
AI micro-credential enrolments up 181%, against 122% globally.
AI security courses grew 296% in India, 665% globally.
Critical thinking enrolments grew 65%, against 107% globally.
Bain: 2.3 million AI openings by 2027, talent pool of 1.2 million.
source_note: Sources: Coursera Global Skills Report 2026; Bain & Company; EY India
